summary: In _has_specific_effects() (line 526), constraint markers (while/without/under/above/below/when) unconditionally override vague-term detection. An effect like 'optimize while loading' has vague_only=True and has_constraint=True; line 526 fires has_constraint first, returning True (SPECIFIC) instead of False (VAGUE). This inflates _score_proposal() from 0.75 to 1.0 for such effects, and the inflated score is recorded as candidate_value in the eval_receipt — misrepresenting quality in the audit trail. No existing test covers vague+constraint combination.
